summary: Next.js App Router leverages React Server Components (RSC) by default, rendering components on the server without shipping JavaScript to the client unless marked with 'use client'.
details: Benefits include zero-bundle-size server components, streaming with Suspense, nested layouts, and server actions for type-safe mutations without manual API routes.

summary: RAG is an AI framework that retrieves relevant documents from external knowledge sources and passes them as context to a language model to generate grounded, factually accurate answers.
details: RAG overcomes hallucinations, eliminates the need for expensive model retraining, and enables real-time access to private or proprietary datasets.

summary: Proper indexing on foreign keys (e.g., conversationId in messages) and filter fields (e.g., clerkUserId in conversations) prevents costly sequential table scans.
details: In Prisma schema, use @@index([clerkUserId]) and @@index([conversationId]) to ensure O(log n) lookups across millions of chat threads.

summary: Quantum computers replace classical binary bits with qubits. Qubits can exist as linear combinations of |0⟩ and |1⟩ states simultaneously via superposition.
details: Entanglement links pairs of qubits so that measuring one determines the state of the other. Quantum algorithms like Shor's and Grover's utilize quantum interference to amplify correct solution amplitudes.

summary: Event-driven architecture decouples producers from consumers using asynchronous event streams, ensuring high scalability and fault tolerance.
details: Key patterns include Event Sourcing (rebuilding state from sequential log), CQRS (separating read and write models), and Dead Letter Queues (handling unprocessable messages).

summary: SOLID principles guide robust object-oriented and modular system design: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion.
details: Applying these principles reduces code coupling, enhances testability with unit mocks, and isolates changes to prevent cascading regressions.

summary: Modern authentication separates token issuance from token verification, using short-lived JWTs, secure HTTP-only cookies, and OAuth2/OIDC flows.
details: Zero trust architecture requires continuous verification of user identity, request body validation, and tenant-level authorization checks on every database access.

summary: QuickSort partitions an array around a chosen pivot element, recursively sorting sub-arrays on either side of the pivot with average O(n log n) runtime.
details: Best performance is achieved using median-of-three pivot selection or randomized pivots to prevent worst-case O(n^2) degradation on pre-sorted arrays.

topic: ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Champions (1975-2023)
summary: The ICC Men's Cricket World Cup winners: 1975 & 1979: West Indies; 1983: India; 1987: Australia; 1992: Pakistan; 1996: Sri Lanka; 1999, 2003, 2007: Australia; 2011: India; 2015: Australia; 2019: England; 2023: Australia. Australia leads with 6 titles; India & West Indies have 2 each.
details: India won in 1983 (captain Kapil Dev defeating West Indies) and 2011 (captain MS Dhoni defeating Sri Lanka at Wankhede Stadium). Australia won a record 6 titles (1987, 1999, 2003, 2007, 2015, 2023).

summary: The 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup took place in India from Oct 5 to Nov 19, 2023. Australia won the title, defeating undefeated India by 6 wickets in the final in Ahmedabad. Travis Head scored 137 in the final. Virat Kohli was Player of the Tournament (765 runs); Mohammed Shami took the most wickets (24).
details: 10 teams competed in 48 matches. India finished top of the group with 9/9 wins, defeated New Zealand in Semi-Final 1 (Mohammed Shami 7/57, Virat Kohli 117). Australia defeated South Africa in Semi-Final 2 and chased 241 in the final led by Travis Head's century.

summary: Cricket has three main international formats: Test (5 days, two innings each), ODI (One Day International, 50 overs per side), and T20 (Twenty20, 20 overs per side). Key rules include LBW (Leg Before Wicket), DRS (Decision Review System), DLS (Duckworth-Lewis-Stern rain method), and Powerplays (fielding restriction periods).
details: In ODIs: Mandatory Powerplay 1 (overs 1-10, max 2 fielders outside 30-yard circle), Powerplay 2 (overs 11-40, max 4 outside), Powerplay 3 (overs 41-50, max 5 outside). Batting strike rate is runs scored per 100 balls; bowling economy is runs conceded per over.

summary: Sachin Tendulkar holds the world record for 100 international centuries and 18,426 ODI runs. Virat Kohli surpassed Tendulkar with 50 ODI centuries (80 international tons). Rohit Sharma has the highest individual ODI score (264 vs Sri Lanka) and 3 ODI double centuries. MS Dhoni is the only captain to win all three ICC white-ball trophies (2007 T20 WC, 2011 ODI WC, 2013 Champions Trophy).
details: Muttiah Muralitharan took 800 Test wickets (world record); Shane Warne took 708 Test wickets. Brian Lara scored 400 not out in Tests. Jasprit Bumrah and Mohammed Shami are premier modern pace bowlers.

summary: The Cricket dataset includes 6 primary relational tables: cricket_world_cups (tournaments from 1975 to 2023), cricket_world_cup_matches (all 48 matches of 2023 World Cup), cricket_squads (team rosters and roles), cricket_player_stats (career ODI/Test stats for top cricketers), icc_rankings (team rankings by format), and ipl_tournaments (IPL season history).
details: Matches table tracks ID, Year, Date, Stage, Team 1, Team 2, Venue, Winner, Margin, Player of Match, and Host Team. The world cups table tracks Year, Host Country, Winner, Runners-Up, Player of Tournament, Top Run Scorer, Top Wicket Taker, Qualified Teams, and Matches Played.

topic: FIFA World Cup 2022 Qatar Records & Winners
summary: Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar, defeating defending champions France 4-2 on penalties following an iconic 3-3 draw in the final at Lusail Stadium. Lionel Messi was awarded the Golden Ball (best player), Kylian Mbappé won the Golden Boot (8 goals, including a final hat-trick), and Emiliano Martínez won the Golden Glove.
details: Croatia finished 3rd, defeating Morocco (4th). 64 matches were played across 8 stadiums in Qatar from November 20 to December 18, 2022.

topic: Football World Cup Database Schema & Datasets
summary: The Football World Cup dataset includes 4 relational tables: world_cups (historical tournaments, hosts, winners, goals scored), world_cup_groups (group stages, points, FIFA rankings), world_cup_squads (player rosters, positions, age, caps, goals, clubs), and 2022_world_cup_matches (all 64 tournament matches in Qatar with dates, stages, home/away teams, and host flags).
details: The 2022_world_cup_matches table maps all 64 tournament fixtures from Match 1 (Qatar vs Ecuador) through Match 64 (Argentina vs France Final).

summary: The Indian Premier League (IPL) is the premier T20 franchise league. Mumbai Indians (MI) and Chennai Super Kings (CSK) lead with 5 titles each, followed by Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) with 3 titles. Virat Kohli is the all-time highest run-scorer, and Yuzvendra Chahal is the leading wicket-taker.
details: CSK won in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023 under MS Dhoni. MI won in 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020 under Rohit Sharma. KKR won in 2012, 2014, and 2024 under Shreyas Iyer / Gautam Gambhir.
